entity_geography.text: A 2026 02 OP - Development and maintenance of learning products for the EU Agency for Railways Annex 3: Standard forms The standard forms are to be completed and provided as part of your offer. Identification of the tenderer : Business Partner Form The tenderer (or the single point of contact in case of joint tender) must provide a Business Partner Form and supporting documents. To mitigate risk and contain the issue, all assets will be securely wrapped and packaged in protective materials prior to being placed into the storage containers, preventing any further spread of mold.
